Ghost Venom

Track custom BLE devices on Apple's Find My network. Features real-time location tracking, multi-user support, directional finding with compass guidance, and comprehensive BLE scanning capabilities.

IP Lizard

Professional IP address intelligence and geolocation tool. Identify IP origins, VPN detection, threat analysis, and comprehensive network reconnaissance for security investigations.

LinkUp Elite

Advanced link tracking and metadata extraction. Analyze URLs, extract embedded information, detect phishing attempts, and investigate suspicious web links with detailed analysis.

MacVenom Pro

Comprehensive macOS security and surveillance detection tool. Scan for hidden microphones, detect network anomalies, analyze system vulnerabilities, and protect your privacy.

PCMD Live

Call detail record analysis and triangulation tool. Analyze carrier PCMD files, identify hot towers, perform V-Strike triangulation, and track movement patterns with real-time ping location tracking.

RF Scorpion

Professional RF security and surveillance detection. Detect fake cell towers (Stingrays), identify GPS trackers, analyze EMF radiation, and detect hidden microphones for comprehensive security assessments.

Socialpede

Professional OSINT investigation tool. Search 40+ platforms for usernames, perform phone and email intelligence, analyze images with EXIF extraction, and monitor targets with watchlist functionality.

ToadCAM

Infrared camera detection and surveillance mapping. Detect hidden cameras using IR scanning, discover nearby network cameras, and visualize surveillance coverage with DeFlock ALPR mapping technology.

SRT Let's Talk

Professional streaming and communication app for secure, real-time video and audio broadcasting. Features SRT/RTMP streaming, one-touch Mediator calling, remote SMS control, and GPS location sharing with floor detection.
